title: 15 August 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
This was The Beatles’ 125th lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club. It was also the 38th occasion on which they performed both lunchtime and evening shows at the venue.

The group’s lunchtime shows typically lasted from 12-2pm. This was their 215th known appearance overall at the soon-to-be-famous cellar venue on Mathew Street in Liverpool’s city centre.

Although the precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
